items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I've read so little the last few years that even people like, say, Leroy Jones and all those who went in, for blues in particular. But I've read a little, but not very much of their work either, actually.

ctx.x: He was a black writer. Yeah. Yeah. Which leads to a question I have. All right. Well, what, are there any black critics or writers of jazz that you are particularly interested in? Or would you venture to say why you don't think more blacks have written about their own creations?
Well, I just don't know. I've never, actually, I've read so little the last few years that even people like, say, Leroy Jones and all those who went in,
for blues in particular. But I've read a little, but not very much of their work either, actually.
